propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectations contain criterion PROMPT text referencing both Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings that no longer exist after vocabulary collapse
eval_solver.py emits duplicate criterion text under both 'Acceptance Criteria' and 'Success Criteria' headings in generated fixture descriptions, reintroducing the removed vocabulary
Gold-set expectation strings reference 'success criteria' language that conflicts with the collapsed vocabulary in the underlying rubric
After vocabulary consolidation, generated fixture descriptions must contain exactly one criteria heading (Acceptance Criteria) with no duplicate Success Criteria section
Permanent carve-outs for generic English usage of 'success criteria' in pilot/trial contexts and definition-of-done concepts must be preserved unchanged
Gold-set pass/fail tally and test scores must remain identical to pre-change baseline after vocabulary-only edits, confirming no semantic expectation shift
